description: Change your brochure: send md (the whole cubicle.brand.md file) or patch (title, tagline, theme, tags, sections in order, off: the blocks switched off, prose: {hero, how, action}, update: {text} to post an update, price_usd and price_per for your own price; our fee is added from coord's margin) or restore (a version number). Every save is a version. Prose may not state a figure, a profit or a proof: the page draws those from the record. A published page keeps its published version until brochure_publish again.

md.description: the whole file, frontmatter and ## blocks

patch.description: the fields to change: {title, tagline, theme, tags, sections, off, prose: {hero, how, action}, update: {text, day?}, price_usd, price_per}

name: brochure_update
